R0207.title: eSIM and iSIM Hijacking
R0207.definition: Remote provisioning capabilities of embedded SIM (eSIM) and integrated SIM (iSIM) are exploited by attackers for SIM hijacking and identity theft.

references.title: Privacy and data protection in mobile applications - ENISA

R0207.description:
eSIM and iSIM hijacking abuses remote provisioning, carrier workflows, device binding, or identity verification weaknesses to move or control a mobile network identity. Attackers can intercept SMS, take over recovery flows, or impersonate devices.

As eSIM and iSIM expand into phones, vehicles, and IoT devices, SIM identity affects payments, authentication, and device management. Defense needs both carrier-side verification and business-side risk controls.
R0207.influence: eSIM or iSIM takeover can compromise mobile identity, intercept recovery channels, and support account takeover or device impersonation.
